## Join me to Build, Protect, and Lead California.
### I’m running for governor to make sure that California keeps rising – that we’re building our economy while working hard to protect your rights and freedoms in the state we love.
## The Case for Xavier Becerra
Californians know all about disasters, but Donald Trump is a man-made natural disaster attacking Californians every day. As California’s Attorney General, Xavier Becerra sued the Trump Administration more than 120 times, and won landmark victories protecting Obamacare, working Californians and Dreamers from attacks.
As the US Secretary for Health and Human Services, he expanded health coverage to more than 24 million Americans and stood up to drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions. Xavier Becerra is the only candidate for Governor with the experience to tackle the man-made crises of the Trump Administration on Day One. He doesn’t just complain about Trump– Becerra beats him, and Californians win.
Learn More
